avalanche.travel_advice: Watch for signs of unstable snow such as recent avalanches, cracking in the snow, and audible collapsing. Avoid traveling on or under similar slopes.

facts: No new snow measured at the 3 nearby stations in the 72 hours to Sep 28.

facts.text: Snow left 3 nearby stations 21 to 40 days earlier this year than the median of the three earlier seasons on file (2023 to 2025).

evidence.name: Lone Pine
evidence.detail: left May 11; earlier seasons: June 22 (2023), June 20 (2024), June 15 (2025)

evidence.name: Pinto Rock
evidence.detail: left May 4; earlier seasons: June 6 (2023), June 5 (2024), June 1 (2025)

evidence.name: Spencer Meadow
evidence.detail: left April 24; earlier seasons: May 30 (2023), May 15 (2024), May 14 (2025)

facts.text: This year's highest snow water on or after April 1 was the lowest of the four seasons on file (2023 to 2026) at all 3 nearby stations.

evidence.name: Lone Pine
evidence.detail: 16.8 in on April 2; earlier seasons: 55.2 in (2023), 37.3 in (2024), 47.2 in (2025)

evidence.name: Pinto Rock
evidence.detail: 16.5 in on April 3; earlier seasons: 50.6 in (2023), 31.1 in (2024), 41.2 in (2025)

evidence.name: Spencer Meadow
evidence.detail: 8.8 in on April 2; earlier seasons: 39.1 in (2023), 21.4 in (2024), 25.9 in (2025)

facts.text: An estimate: snow left the pass itself between April 9 and June 1, carried from the melt-out dates at 3 nearby stations to the pass elevation.

evidence.name: Lone Pine
evidence.detail: melted out May 11, 140 ft below the pass; points to April 21 to June 5

evidence.name: Pinto Rock
evidence.detail: melted out May 4, 370 ft above the pass; points to April 3 to May 22

evidence.name: Spencer Meadow
evidence.detail: melted out April 24, 680 ft below the pass; points to April 9 to June 1
